preconditions.description: Number of cities is between 2 and 500.
Number of roads is between 0 and n*(n-1)/2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi and 1 <= li <= 10**6 for xi, yi, li in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities with positive lengths.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n*(n-1)/2 integers.
Each count of roads on shortest paths is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(cst == sum(1 for road in roads if road in shortest_paths[s][t]) for s in range(n) for t in range(s + 1, n))
postconditions.description: Each count of roads on shortest paths is correctly calculated.
